Title: Retirement: AI Services Metrics Advisor is retired as of May 18, 2026

Body.Content:
Azure AI Metrics Advisor has been retired as of May 18, 2026.

We recommend the following alternatives:

  1. Azure Monitor, as an official Azure 3P product, anomaly detection and analysis capabilities are provided through multiple interfaces, e.g., Detect and analyze anomalies with KQL in Azure Monitor - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Learn 
  2. The Open-Source Anomaly Detector, this open-source project provides the same anomaly detection capabilities used by Kensho, Azure Metrics Advisor, and Azure Anomaly Detector in the backend
  3. Fabric, learn more:
    • Overview & tutorial: Multivariate anomaly detection overview - Microsoft Fabric | Microsoft Learn
    • Techcommunity blog: Advanced Time Series Anomaly Detector in Fabric - Microsoft Community 

 Help and support   

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A.

If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.   

  1. For Issue type, select Technical. 
  2. For Subscription, select your subscription. 
  3. For Service, select My services, then select Cognitive Services. 
  4. Select the Azure resource that you are creating a support request for. 
  5. For Summary, type a description of your issue. 
  6. For Problem type, select  Availability. 
  7. For problem subtype, select  Service Unavailable
